name: Hakoniwa no Asa to Madowaku no Yoru
source:
Saeki, a third-year high school student, is an ordinary boy with a little inspiration. There are rumors of a ghost at the school Saeki attends.

During the winter vacation before the exam, Saeki met the ghost, Kujo.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/29441]Freem![/url]]
